findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Avatar Fetch API
findings.severity: AI-proposed severity: CRITICAL — pending human review
findings.notes: Backend downloads remote images using axios without restricting loopback/private IPv4 ranges. Internal admin panel accessible via probe.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search Query
findings.severity: AI-proposed severity: HIGH — pending human review
findings.notes: Parameter 'q' is reflected unsanitized into the response HTML body without encoding or Content-Security-Policy restriction.
